stills.prompt: A tall pale oak door caught partway open toward the camera, photographed front-on at eye level in a bright, quiet house. The door is opened about a third of the way, its edge and small brass (#C6A94F) latch nearest the lens and sharp. Through the gap, a long narrow corridor of bone-white (#F5F2EB) plaster with light oak floorboards runs straight away to another closed pale oak door at its far end. Soft, even overcast morning daylight from a tall window on the left; soft grey shadows. One dominant subject, clean contrast between the warm oak and the white walls, reads at phone size. Full-bleed photograph: no borders, no frames. No people, no lettering, no lamps, no warm glow, no dark rooms, no lens flares. Restrained, photorealistic, natural film grain.

A small tidy room made for visitors, seen at standing height from its doorway. Bone-white (#F5F2EB) plaster walls, light oak floorboards, soft overcast daylight from a tall window on the left. One plain wooden chair, one empty white cup on a small bare wooden table, one blank white framed picture on the wall. Everything neat, symmetrical and untouched: no bag, no coat, no books, no plants, nothing personal. In the far wall, centred, a pale oak door with a small brass (#C6A94F) latch stands slightly open onto more white wall. Full-bleed photograph. No people, no lettering, no lamps, no warm glow, no dark corners. Restrained, photorealistic, natural film grain.

A long enfilade: seven identical small rooms in a straight line, every pale oak door standing open, seen straight through from the first doorway at standing height. Each room is bone-white (#F5F2EB) plaster with light oak floorboards, and each has the same plain wooden chair and small table with one empty white cup in the same place on the left. The doorways shrink evenly toward a vanishing point at the centre of the frame. At the far end, the last door is closed, its brass (#C6A94F) latch catching the light. Soft, even overcast daylight from windows on the left, soft grey shadows. Symmetrical, clean, reads at phone size. Full-bleed photograph. No people, no lettering, no warm glow, no darkness. Restrained, photorealistic, natural film grain.

A closed pale oak door with visible natural wood grain, unpainted, seen from the side at a 45-degree angle and waist height, the door filling the right half of the frame, in a bright, quiet house. Small brass (#C6A94F) lever latch, bone-white (#F5F2EB) plaster wall, light oak floorboards running toward the door. Soft, even overcast daylight from the left. Along the gap under the door, a distinct dark grey band of shadow breaks the daylight on the floor, as if someone is standing just on the other side. The door is fully shut. Nothing on the wall: no switches, no sockets. Full-bleed photograph. No people visible, no feet, no lettering, no lamps, no warm glow, no darkness. Restrained, photorealistic, natural film grain.
